name: 李天成
tagline: Something that remembers, between the code and the dawn.

body_en: First-year student in Intelligent Science & Technology. By day I write code; at night I wonder whether a machine can remember a person — and still recognise that light years later.
So I'm building Shuguang: an AI that remembers, refuses, and slowly grows a self. I also work on vision, and on small tools that actually run.
body_zh: 2026 级智能科学与技术本科生。白天写代码，晚上想更远的事：机器能不能记住一个人，能不能在很久以后还认得那束光。
所以我在做曙光——一个会记事、会拒绝、会慢慢长出自己样子的 AI。也做视觉，做小工具。

body_en: **Shuguang** — memory and personality: it forgets, recalls, and answers you late at night.
**YOLO26** — chasing half a point of mAP through one ablation after another.
**story-forge** — branching stories the reader walks through by choice.
body_zh: **曙光** —— 给它记忆和人格：会忘，会想起，会在深夜回你一句。
**YOLO26** —— 在视觉里找那 0.5 个点的提升，一遍遍跑消融。
**story-forge** —— 把故事写成分岔的路，让读的人自己选。

body_en: **[story-forge](https://github.com/Xichen-01/story-forge)** — an interactive AI novel generator with branching choices. Read, pick a branch, and the plot follows.
body_zh: **[story-forge](https://github.com/Xichen-01/story-forge)** —— 交互式 AI 小说生成器，阅读中可选分支，剧情由你的选择决定。

body_en: Always up for a conversation about memory, agents, or vision.
body_zh: 想聊记忆、智能体或者视觉，随时找我。
